name: services/instaddr/create
description:
Create institutional address.

Currently calling this method with access token causes a method_forbidden error.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description:
LangDict with the name of the institutional address. No more than 100 characters.

Currently English name of the institutional address is ignored.

arguments.name: email
arguments.description: Email of the institutional address. No more than 100 characters.

arguments.name: fac_id
arguments.description: Faculty ID. Only administrators from this faculty will be able to modify it and change assigned users.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • inst_address_id - institutional address ID.
errors:
• object_invalid - object is in invalid state.

    Possible reasons:

    • email_duplicated - email address is already in use.

  • object_not_found - faculty could not be found; param_name is equal to fac_id.
